common_evidence_points: The source is an official GOV.UK primary page from UKHSA.
The page was live-opened successfully on 1 August 2026.

Its scope is source-specific and should not be generalised beyond the stated population, disease, setting or period.
Operational use requires confirmation of the current page version and supporting evidence.
A notification or checklist alone does not establish that every recommendation applies.
Final decisions require current official, clinical, laboratory, epidemiological and governance evidence.
